title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 5: the ark among the Philistines, Dagon fallen before it, and the tumors in Ashdod, Gath and Ekron.

questions.text: From where did the Philistines bring God's ark to Ashdod?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 5:1 says the Philistines brought God's ark from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

questions.text: Where did the Philistines set God's ark?
questions.explanation: They brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

answers.text: In the palace of the king of Ashdod
In the house of Dagon, beside Dagon
In a tent in the field

questions.text: What had happened to Dagon when the people of Ashdod rose early the next day?
questions.explanation: Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh's ark, and they set him in his place again.

answers.text: He had been carried out of the house
He had fallen on his face before Yahweh's ark
He had been burned to ashes

questions.text: On the following morning, what was the only part of Dagon still intact?
questions.explanation: Dagon's head and both palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold; only his torso was intact.

questions.text: Because of what happened, what do the priests of Dagon not step on?
questions.explanation: Neither the priests of Dagon nor anyone who comes into Dagon's house steps on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod.

questions.text: With what did Yahweh strike the people of Ashdod?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he struck them with tumors.

questions.text: After the lords of the Philistines were gathered, where was the ark carried from Ashdod?
questions.explanation: When all the lords of the Philistines were gathered, the answer was, "Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath," and they carried it there.

questions.text: After the ark came to Gath, whom did Yahweh strike there?
questions.explanation: Yahweh struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

answers.text: Only the lords of the Philistines
The men of the city, both small and great
Only the soldiers guarding the ark

questions.text: What did the Ekronites cry out when God's ark came to Ekron?
questions.explanation: They cried that the ark of the God of Israel had been brought to them to kill them and their people.

answers.text: That it had been brought to kill them and their people
That it would bring them victory in battle
That it should be placed in their temple
That they wanted to keep it forever

questions.text: Where did the cry of the city go up?
questions.explanation: The men who didn't die were struck with tumors, and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
